name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: An animated checkbox for React and shadcn, with an indeterminate state for parent checkboxes.

meta.details: A Base UI checkbox whose check draws itself and morphs into the indeterminate dash. The box presses in and springs back, and a parent checkbox fills, dashes and clears with its group.

docs: Import Checkbox and CheckboxGroup from components/eased/checkbox/checkbox. Checkbox: checked, defaultChecked, onCheckedChange, indeterminate, parent, value, name, disabled, children (label), description. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
